P01.note: Steward only carries out court orders and punishes no one; 'single steward' and 'charter' kill diffuse and customary.

P02.note: Open debate reaching shared views = forum; 'heard each other out' kills battleground, clearinghouse only weakly excluded.

P03.note: Essay anticipated the style but nobody read it until 1930, so heralded not guided; hindered has no planted kill.

P04.note: Later surveys calibrated against them = touchstones; 'changed nothing at the time' kills watersheds.

P05.note: Rewrote doubtful lines to read as pious; no pictures, nothing inserted, found order kill the rest.

P06.note: First canvas in new manner that all later work follows; signed openly / entirely his own kill hoax, hybrid, homage.

P07.note: Growth rate dates walls; pollution tolerance, bare stone, arrival after building kill sentinel, scaffold, vestige.

P08.note: Branches sprang up wherever it circulated; took no side, founded first year, branches self-funded kill the rest.

P09.note: Copied abandoned design and lagged; interlocked, freely shared, crashed kill modular, proprietary, resilient.

P10.note: A third of pines died; growth returned, still dominate canopy, suffered as badly kill stunted, sidelined, toughened.

P11.note: Learned as a girl and used almost without thinking throughout = ingrained; fills canvas, affection kill incidental, ironic.

P12.note: Passes orders on and keeps a cut; forwards complaints, alphabetical listing, national firms earlier kill the rest.

P13.note: Kept as memento of kindness; never followed advice and published anyway kill lodestar and lifeline.

P14.note: Knocked on doors and ran meetings then withdrew; spokespeople bargained, so not negotiator or observer.

P15.note: Forty meters in seventy years; plain in photos, even pace, no regain kill stealthy, sporadic, short-lived.

P16.note: Under one part in a thousand = shallow; smooth slide and 3-week/2-year asymmetry kill the others, but a recovered dip is also transient.

P17.note: Written code, scheduled contests, trophy; told as court papers did, held free, more fights kill the rest.

P18.note: Cut three of twelve routes; same streets, ran them itself kill redrawn and privatized.

P19.note: Wide loops became one channel without a bend; not blocked long, old line, above ground kill the rest.

P20.note: Omits divorce and bankruptcy, measured prose; no credit to bandmates and decade of revision kill gracious, glib.

P21.note: Full amount returned; billed once, matched flyer, small enough kill recurring, misleading, prohibitive.

P22.note: New name and screen, code unchanged; kept running, own program, no line changed kill the rest.

P23.note: All workshops moved to one island; kept making, plain good, old pace kill abandoned, elevated, doubled.

P24.note: Petitions turned to blockades and arson; quarrels died after repeal kills entrenched, channeled weakly excluded.

P25.note: Flat fee takes largest share from poorest; next month, line by line, just covered cost kill the rest.

P26.note: Slack dialogue, admirers wince; no pause, settled in last act, added late kill interlude, hinge, kernel.

P27.note: Copied scheme sweeping every city; unchanged 30 years, short form, generous kill experimental, cumbersome, frugal.

P28.note: Mock-heroic delivery made tragedy laughable; every scene kept in order, nothing added kill the rest.

P29.note: River over the bar drowned larvae; plants untouched, spit reappeared kill starved, stranded.

P30.note: Drafted fast for a temporary need; mocked pledges, two clauses, actually used kill candid, exhaustive, ceremonial.

P31.note: Restored incomes then repealed, job done; no other fishery, courts upheld kill precedent, overreach.

P32.note: Nearly twice the usual number arrived; left together, usual week, full distance kill the rest.
